ruling: karaka dasha roles (SS N-69, S-L1 mandatory)
description: chart_dashas.karaka_role_at_period and karakas_active_during_period (and the karaka_school provenance suffix appended to citation_human on the rows that carry a role claim) follow each chart's OWN ga_sensitive kn_rao_rahu_included karaka_chara_position assignments, read by stored rank, instead of one hard-coded lord->role dict (Sun AK, Mars AmK, Mercury BK, Saturn MK, Jupiter PK, Venus GK, Moon DK) applied to every chart. Rahu now carries a role (the old dict had none); Ketu, sign lords (chara_karaka, kalachakra, narayana) and yogini names stay NULL. NO other chart_dashas column moves BY THIS LANE: row set, lords, dates, start_iso/end_iso, durations, natal context and tiers are unchanged by this lane, and emission order of karakas_active_during_period is unchanged (fixed graha order Sun Mars Mercury Saturn Jupiter Venus Moon, Rahu appended). The ephemeris backend move (Moshier to .se1) is a separate lane and does move chart_dashas start_iso / end_iso, dates and durations (Vimshottari +6,992 s, Kalachakra +40 h 18 m, KP with its parent, Mudda 0 to +1 s with one -43 s step) and the level-4 row set of Vimshottari and Kalachakra; it is declared in ephemeris_backend_shift.json, not here. DETECTOR LIMIT, stated plainly: flip_detector.py reads chart_dashas only as (lord path, start, end) rows, so it cannot see these column values; this hook therefore declares the lane's detector-visible footprint as an exact-zero row-set change (nothing appears or disappears) and carries the column-level expectation in this text and in the W7 hand read-back list. Offline OLD-vs-NEW counts (live chart_dashas joined to the stored kn_rao rank->graha assignments per ayanamsha; the old model was first reproduced against stored values with 0 mismatches on all three charts; ayanamsha totals summed across the 5 ayanamshas; systems vimshottari, vimshottari_kp, ashtottari, mudda, naisargika carry the fields): canonical 482012f1 rows with karaka_role_at_period changed 185,883 (value->other value 159,175; NULL->value 26,708 (Rahu lords); value->NULL 0; equal by coincidence 9,630), karakas_active_during_period changed 205,157; chart 1c826d5a role changed 154,981 (127,928 / 27,053 / 0 / equal 42,585), active changed 195,639; chart cb73cd3d role changed 192,473 (161,620 / 30,853 / 0 / equal 30,440), active changed 228,957. chara_karaka, kalachakra, narayana, yogini, scope_cap: 0 rows change by this lane. Counts are of the live (pre-rebuild, Moshier-built) row sets. The .se1 rebuild changes those row sets only at level 4 of Vimshottari (sub-day Sukshma rows crossing a UTC midnight; measured on the canonical chart, no window-edge row moves), declared per ayanamsha in ephemeris_backend_shift.json (net level-4 rows lahiri +12, true_chitra +2, krishnamurti +1, raman -9, surya_siddhanta -6), so the Vimshottari figures above can move by those rows; Abhinandan and Kiran were not measured. Full per-chart per-system table: KARAKA_DASHA_ROLES_INTENT_v1_0.md section 6.

may_change.expected_direction: this lane makes no chart_dashas row appear or disappear: it rewrites karaka_role_at_period and karakas_active_during_period (and the citation_human suffix) on existing rows only; row set, lords, start_iso / end_iso, dates, durations and tiers are unchanged by this lane. The backend move of start_iso / end_iso and of level-4 Vimshottari / Kalachakra rows is declared in ephemeris_backend_shift.json.
may_change.note: This lane's own footprint is an exact-0 row-set change on the three systems that carry the karaka columns and are NOT touched by the ephemeris backend move (ashtottari, mudda, naisargika; the one Mudda -43 s start step is a shift, not a row-set change). vimshottari and vimshottari_kp also carry the karaka columns but were REMOVED from this entry's categories: a rebuild on the .se1 backend moves their start times (+6,992 s) and the Vimshottari level-4 row set (declared per ayanamsha in ephemeris_backend_shift.json), and under this lane's exact-0 claim that move read EXPECTATION_MISMATCH 292 vs 0 (analysis P1) and would have hidden a genuine karaka-lane row-set change among the 292. REPLACES the earlier dasha_shift entry with shift_range_sec [0, 0], which could never match a shifted row (the detector ignores shifts of 2 s or less and only matches larger ones), so it always read DECLARED_BUT_ABSENT on an unchanged chart. The detector cannot see the lane's real change (karaka_role_at_period / karakas_active_during_period are columns it never reads: column-level counts are in the description and in the W7 hand read-back list HOOKS_W7_HAND_READBACK_v1_0.md). What it CAN see is the row set, and the lane promises zero row-set change. source: rehearsal-synthetic (19-lane rehearsal, flip_detector v2.3 compare against the origin/main baseline build on the same synthetic chart; HOOKS_COMPLETENESS_v1_0.md, Source evidence) (chart_dashas 429,583 rows before and after, no appeared / disappeared). Cross-lane: none of the three systems here has a row set the ephemeris backend changes (ephemeris_backend_shift's last entry asserts the same exact 0 on them); a nonzero count here is a finding of THIS lane, not the backend.
